I inspected the chart you provided and it is too blurry to read the axis labels or tick values reliably. Because of that I cannot determine the exact value of the tallest bar — I don’t want to guess a precise number from unreadable text.

Options I can do now:
- If you can upload a higher-resolution or less-blurry version (or a tight crop around the axes and the tallest bar), I can read/estimate the value more accurately.
- If you can share the underlying data (CSV, table, or the numbers used to make the chart), I can give the exact value immediately.
- If you prefer an approximate value from the current image, I can try to estimate a range by measuring pixel height vs. visible gridlines, but that will be imprecise and I’ll state the uncertainty.

If you want the approximation, tell me which you prefer (approximate range from this image, or you’ll upload a clearer image or the data).
